newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka gains at close on dollar supply.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka gains at close on dollar supply.

text.p: Increased dollar supply before a two-day public holiday helped the Bangladesh taka close firmer on Saturday at 42.5470/5480 to the dollar in interbank trading, compared with the previous close of 42.5480/5490, dealers said.

The local unit was quoted at 54.5475/5495 per dollar in early trade but gained later, dealers said. "Dollar demand was as usual low due to weekend closure of international markets. Also, banks were more interested in local currency because of rising call money rates," said one dealer.
The call money was traded at six to 6.75 percent, slightly up from previous 5.75-6.75 percent, dealers said.
